title: `merge --reviewed` checks a review record's claims against the diff paths at read time
why: Coordinator, 14:09 CST Nov 7: #1437 closed as replaced by #1353 (merge-guard-flag-from-paths). This is the part of #1437 that #1353 left out.
note: Starts after step pr-state-is-on-the-pr. Lane merge-guard-flag-from-paths ([ended:lane:-merge-guard-flag-from-paths]) confirmed the gap at 22:34 CST Nov 7: refuse_owed_round (#1773) and --reviewed read only the record's label, so a hand-written record gets past. Fix: run #1353's guard_hits in both, through one helper. Also starts after #1773. Same owner ask as merge-guard-flag-from-paths (ask-mw59xljoxp), so the hold lets it start.
